<div class="card-body">
'''Radar Scanner''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">レーダー・スキャナー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">場のカードに自分のビークルまたは宇宙船が１枚以上あれば、１フォース消費して、１０秒間、相手の手札を覗くことができる。ジャワ（除くダスカチャ）とタスケン・レイダーを見つけたら、相手のユーズドデッキへ置いてよい。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-104o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ルークのランドスピーダーに装備されているセンサー。多機能。生命体や、金属体の移動、集積を感知可能。植民星での交通管制にも使用されている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Radar Scanner.

'''Card text:''' If you have at least one vehicle or starship on table, use 1 Force to look at the opponent's hand for 10 seconds. You may place each Jawa (except Dathcha) and Tusken Raider you find there in the opponent's Used Pile.

'''Lore:''' Sensors mounted on Luke's landspeeder. Multi-function. Can detect life forms and the movement or clustering of metal. Also used for traffic control on colony worlds.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Radar Scanner]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
